answer: A newcomer proves one identity with a basalt quarry certificate: its quarry number, blast record, and surveyor signature are filed with the wharf quarry desk and checked against the vertex quarry registry in an hour. The wharf desk matches certificate and signature. A certificate reused under another name fails, and the person is barred for a cycle, forfeiting 410 units. An honest newcomer pays 410 units once; a thousand fakes pay 410,000. A farm reusing one quarry for a thousand clones fails: the quarry works one pit only, so one quarry binds to one owner.
